posSettings.title: POS Settings
posSettings.subtitle: Business switches pushed from head office to POS terminals. Hardware settings (printer, card terminal, scanner) stay on each terminal.

cashMovement.name: Cash in / out
cashMovement.desc: Deposit, withdraw and today's log in the side-bar cash drawer panel

noSaleRescan.name: Re-scan staff code for No Sale
noSaleRescan.desc: Ask for a staff code on No Sale even when the user has permission

returnsRescan.name: Re-scan staff code for returns
returnsRescan.desc: Scan the staff code again when Return is tapped

bankReceipt.name: Attach bank receipt to customer receipt
bankReceipt.desc: Print the bank transaction slip after the card receipt

manualCard.name: Manual card entry
manualCard.desc: Show Manual card on the payment page (no card terminal)

voucher.name: Vouchers / gift cards
voucher.desc: Accept vouchers on the payment page

orderList.name: Order list on payment page
orderList.desc: Show the item list on the left of the payment page

autoRestart.name: Auto restart after daily close
autoRestart.desc: Prompt after daily close and restart the terminal early in the morning

zellerUnmatchedRefund.name: Zeller unmatched refund
zellerUnmatchedRefund.desc: Allow refunds that are not linked to the original transaction

posSettings.readOnlyNote: You have view-only access and cannot change settings.

global.title: Global defaults
global.subtitle: The starting point for every store and device. Not set = nothing is pushed and the terminal keeps its local value.
global.hintDefault: When not set this is treated as {{value}}
global.hintNative: When not set the terminal keeps its local setting
global.adminOnly: Only administrators can save changes to the global defaults.

stores.title: Store overrides
stores.subtitle: Only items that differ from global are listed; stores without overrides follow global
stores.footer: {{total}} stores, {{overridden}} with overrides · devices pick changes up on their next sync (about 1 minute)

storeDrawer.title: Store overrides · {{name}} ({{code}})
storeDrawer.info: Store overrides take priority over global; a single device can still be overridden on the Devices tab.
storeDrawer.noDevices: No devices are registered in this store

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Click a row to edit that device's overrides; reported values come from the terminal after it applies settings
devices.empty: No devices are registered in this store
devices.noStores: No visible stores, so devices cannot be listed

deviceStatus.neverHint: The app version is too old, or it has not been online yet
deviceStatus.pendingHint: There are new changes the device has not reported as applied

deviceDrawer.title: Device settings · {{code}}
deviceDrawer.bannerPending: New changes have not been applied to this device yet
deviceDrawer.bannerNever: This device has never reported its settings: the app is too old, or it has not been online yet
deviceDrawer.offline: Changed locally while offline {{count}} time(s) · last {{time}}
deviceDrawer.footnote: Device reports is the actual value the terminal sent back after applying. When it differs from Should apply it is marked Pending sync.
deviceDrawer.noSettings: This device type has no settings to push

confirm.description: {{count}} change(s). Devices pick them up on their next sync:
